grammar.title: The Subjunctive with Impersonal Expressions (Bisogna che, È necessario che)
grammar.explanation: Impersonal expressions of necessity, possibility, or opinion trigger the subjunctive in Italian: 'bisogna che' (it is necessary that), 'è importante che' (it is important that), 'è possibile che' (it is possible that), 'sembra che' (it seems that). The subjunctive of 'fare' is: faccia, faccia, faccia, facciamo, facciate, facciano. The subjunctive of 'essere' is: sia, sia, sia, siamo, siate, siano. In medical contexts, these are used frequently with formal 'Lei'.

examples.target: Bisogna che Lei prenda la medicina ogni giorno.

It is possible that it is an infection.
